column1: #Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=We can see a small part of an American state.
#Text=There are two large lakes in the middle, Lake Mendota and Lake Monona.
#Text=It looks like a fishing area to the north.
#Text=There is a university to the west and a hiking trail to the south.
#Text=There is a lot of green, so it is a wooded area.
#Text=Further to the east, there is a slightly more urban area next to Lake Monona with roads and major highways.
#Text=There is a botanical garden above the lake.
#Text=It looks like a map from a search engine for tourists looking for accommodation, as we can see a well-rated hotel.
#Text=There is an airport to the north and perhaps a hospital to the northeast.

#Text=Anchors summary  Lake Mendota Lake Monona fishing area (north) university (west) hiking trail (south) wooded/forested area (abundant green) urban area east of Lake Monona with major roads botanical garden (above the lake) well-rated hotel (tourist lodging) airport (north) hospital (possible, northeast)
